chapter: Family and boyhood in Concord and Ione
title: His mother's family: Betsy's emigration and organists
summary: Little musical background on his mother's side except some church organists; his grandmother Betsy's route from White Russia and Poland to California.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: Your mother was a pianist. Were there other musicians in her family?

No. Not that I know of. That family you mentioned being Polish, trying to trace them, we’ve heard that they were in White Russia – her mother. Betsy. Her mother. Then into Poland, and from Poland to Germany, and from Germany she got a way to get to California as a nanny or a servant to the Gangerer – I don’t know how to spell it. Capital G – Iola would know. Then she married Henry Ivy.
When you were in first grade, I believe you were . . .
There were some organists on that side of the family.
